lines.zh: 顺流游，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: Swimming downstream, gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 水草扫过肚皮，痒得摆尾。
lines.en: Weeds sweep my belly and my tail twitches.

lines.zh: 贴着河底走，影子小一点。
lines.en: Hugging the riverbed keeps my shadow small.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，就过了那块石头。
lines.en: One flick of the tail clears that stone.

lines.zh: 前面水变浅了，得拐弯。
lines.en: The water shallows ahead; I must turn.

lines.zh: 水流推着我，省不少力气。
lines.en: The current carries me and saves my strength.

lines.zh: 绕开那张网，昨天见过。
lines.en: Around that net; I saw it yesterday.

lines.zh: 游慢点，别惊动上面的影子。
lines.en: Slower, so the shadow above stays calm.

lines.zh: 从荷叶底下钻过去，凉快。
lines.en: Under the lily pad, cool and quick.

lines.zh: 沙底有东西在动，我避开。
lines.en: Something stirs in the sand; I veer off.

lines.zh: 顺着水沟一直游，能到湖。
lines.en: Follow this channel and I reach the lake.

lines.zh: 鳍划开水面，一圈小波纹。
lines.en: My fin parts the water into small ripples.

lines.zh: 回头看一眼，没有追的。
lines.en: One glance back: nothing is chasing.

lines.zh: 这两颗心，游不了太久。
lines.en: With two hearts, I cannot swim long.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边游，找水草的缝
lines.en: I swim by the bank, looking for gaps in the weeds.

lines.zh: 一条大鱼经过，我沉到沙里
lines.en: A big fish passes and I sink into the sand.

lines.zh: 停在水草里，装成一片叶子。
lines.en: Resting in the weeds, pretending to be a leaf.

lines.zh: 水面上有光斑，晃得眼花。
lines.en: Light spots on the surface dazzle me.

lines.zh: 泡在水里，鳃慢慢动。
lines.en: Soaking here, my gills move slowly.

lines.zh: 等一只水虫游近，再张嘴。
lines.en: Waiting for a water bug to drift close.

lines.zh: 河底的泥暖暖的，正合适。
lines.en: The riverbed mud is warm, just right.

lines.zh: 刚才差点被一只鸭子看见。
lines.en: A duck nearly spotted me just now.

lines.zh: 吹个水泡，目送它破在水面。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it burst above.

lines.zh: 这处水潭安静，没人钓。
lines.en: This pool is quiet; nobody fishes here.

lines.zh: 数头顶经过的影子，三只了。
lines.en: Counting shadows overhead: three so far.

lines.zh: 一动就会露馅，我不动。
lines.en: One move gives me away; so I stay still.

lines.zh: 水里听声音，比岸上清楚。
lines.en: Sound travels clearer underwater than on shore.

lines.zh: 我只有两颗心，得省着用。
lines.en: I have only two hearts; I spend them carefully.

lines.zh: 阳光照到水底，暖洋洋的。
lines.en: Sunlight reaches the bottom, warm and gold.

lines.zh: 甩甩尾巴，把泥抖掉。
lines.en: A tail flick shakes the mud off.

lines.zh: 岸上那个人，影子投下来了。
lines.en: That figure on the bank casts a shadow down.

lines.zh: 那根钓竿我见过，收起来。
lines.en: I have seen that fishing rod; put it away.

lines.zh: 别盯着我，我会游走。
lines.en: Do not stare; I will swim away.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神像在看一盘菜。
lines.en: You look at me like a plated meal.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，鳃都不敢动。
lines.en: I look up, gills held perfectly still.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进水里了，退后。
lines.en: Your boots are in the water; step back.

lines.zh: 我小得可怜，捞了也白捞。
lines.en: I am pitifully small; netting me is wasted work.

lines.zh: 你影子一动，我心就跳快了。
lines.en: Your shadow moves and my heart races.

lines.zh: 隔着水看，你的脸有点歪。
lines.en: Through the water your face looks a little crooked.

lines.zh: 你要是伸手，我就钻泥里。
lines.en: Reach in and I dive into the mud.

lines.zh: 鳞掉了一片，水里都是血味。
lines.en: A scale came off; blood taints the water.

lines.zh: 疼！我要游走了。
lines.en: That hurts! I am swimming off.

lines.zh: 别打了，我只有两颗心。
lines.en: Stop; I have only two hearts.

lines.zh: 泥水翻起来，我找不到北。
lines.en: The mud swirls up and I lose my bearings.

lines.zh: 这一下差点把我拍晕。
lines.en: That nearly knocked me senseless.

lines.zh: 我逃得快，你别追了。
lines.en: I flee fast; stop chasing.

lines.zh: 河底有石头，我撞上去了。
lines.en: There is stone below; I crashed into it.

lines.zh: 血味会把更大的鱼引来。
lines.en: The blood smell will draw bigger fish.

lines.zh: 我还没长大，别这样。
lines.en: I have not grown yet; not like this.

lines.zh: 躲进水草，喘口气。
lines.en: Into the weeds to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 那团红虫，香味飘过来了。
lines.en: Those red worms; the smell drifts over.

lines.zh: 是饵吗？闻着不像钩。
lines.en: Is it bait? It does not smell like a hook.

lines.zh: 我绕两圈，先看看线。
lines.en: Two circles first, to check for line.

lines.zh: 再靠近一寸，就一寸。
lines.en: Just one inch closer, only one.

lines.zh: 香味太浓了，肯定有问题。
lines.en: The smell is too strong; something is wrong.

lines.zh: 嘴张到一半，又赶紧闭上。
lines.en: My mouth opens halfway, then snaps shut.

lines.zh: 谁在水面上撒东西？
lines.en: Who is scattering things on the surface?

lines.zh: 这一口下去，可能就没了。
lines.en: One bite and I may be gone.

lines.zh: 换你你也忍不住，对吧。
lines.en: You would not resist either, would you?

lines.zh: 我碰一下就跑，行不行。
lines.en: Let me touch it and flee, all right?

lines.zh: 被撞得翻了半圈，头晕。
lines.en: Knocked half a turn over; my head spins.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踢到我了，让开。
lines.en: Your boot kicked me; move aside.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑了，看不见路。
lines.en: The water is muddied; I cannot see.

lines.zh: 别拿网兜碰我，鳞要掉了。
lines.en: Not the net; my scales will come off.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我躲进石头缝。
lines.en: That bump sends me into a stone crevice.

lines.zh: 你踩下来的脚太大了。
lines.en: The foot coming down is far too big.

lines.zh: 碰撞把我推出去好远。
lines.en: The collision shoved me a long way out.

lines.zh: 我撞到河壁，嘴边破了。
lines.en: I hit the bank; my lip is split.

lines.zh: 别往里挤，这条沟只容一条鱼。
lines.en: Stop crowding in; this ditch holds one fish.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，你是想抓我？
lines.en: This close — are you trying to catch me?

lines.zh: 同一条沟里，两条影子并排。
lines.en: Two shadows side by side in one channel.

lines.zh: 你的鳞色浅，游得倒稳。
lines.en: Your scales are pale, but you swim steady.

lines.zh: 水草最密的地方，我等你。
lines.en: Where the weeds grow thickest, I wait.

lines.zh: 卵要粘在石头上，别冲走。
lines.en: The eggs cling to stone; do not wash them off.

lines.zh: 绕着水潭转一圈，跟紧我。
lines.en: One lap around the pool; stay close.

lines.zh: 别急，先等鸭子飞过去。
lines.en: Not yet; let the duck fly past first.

lines.zh: 尾巴碰一下，就算说定了。
lines.en: A touch of tails, and it is settled.

lines.zh: 这片浅水安全，可以留下。
lines.en: These shallows are safe; we can stay.

lines.zh: 你的鳍在抖，紧张什么。
lines.en: Your fin is trembling; what are you nervous about?

lines.zh: 两条鱼，总比一条好躲。
lines.en: Two fish hide better than one.

lines.zh: 水底有颗亮东西，捡来看看。
lines.en: Something bright on the bottom; let me check.

lines.zh: 这是面包屑，能吃吗？
lines.en: Is this bread crumb edible?

lines.zh: 我用嘴推了推，是块玻璃。
lines.en: I nudge it with my mouth: a piece of glass.

lines.zh: 捡起来又掉，水太滑。
lines.en: It slips from my mouth; the water is slick.

lines.zh: 谁把钩子丢在水里？
lines.en: Who dropped a hook in the water?

lines.zh: 小石子含在嘴里，硌牙。
lines.en: A pebble in my mouth grinds my teeth.

lines.zh: 这东西比我大，捡不动。
lines.en: This thing is bigger than me; I cannot lift it.

lines.zh: 咽不下去，吐出来。
lines.en: It will not go down; I spit it out.

lines.zh: 水底的铜片，反光晃眼。
lines.en: A copper scrap below flashes in the light.

lines.zh: 捡完赶紧游，别停留。
lines.en: Grab it and swim; do not linger.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子，往这边来了。
lines.en: The shadow on the surface is coming this way.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在动，先看着。
lines.en: Something moves over there; I will watch.

lines.zh: 是你。我记住你的靴子了。
lines.en: It is you; I remember those boots.

lines.zh: 这张网我见过，退。
lines.en: I have seen this net before; back away.

lines.zh: 盯住那个影子，鳃都别动。
lines.en: Fix on that shadow and do not twitch.

lines.zh: 鱼鹰的影子，最要命。
lines.en: A fishing hawk's shadow is the worst.

lines.zh: 左边水浑了，有东西。
lines.en: The water clouded left; something is there.

lines.zh: 先沉到泥里，看清再说。
lines.en: Sink into the mud and look before moving.

lines.zh: 它比我的两颗心危险。
lines.en: It is more dangerous than my two hearts allow.

lines.zh: 确定了，是冲我来的。
lines.en: Confirmed: it is coming for me.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就往反方向游。
lines.en: When it moves, I swim the other way.

lines.zh: 数它划水的节奏，找空档。
lines.en: Counting its stroke rhythm for a gap.

lines.zh: 水面上的手伸下来了。
lines.en: A hand is reaching down through the surface.

lines.zh: 再近半尺，我就钻泥。
lines.en: Half a foot closer and I burrow into mud.

lines.zh: 它堵住出口，我绕石头。
lines.en: It blocked the exit; I go around the stone.

lines.zh: 我的鳍已经绷紧了。
lines.en: My fins are already taut.

lines.zh: 躲那丛水草后面，它看不见。
lines.en: Behind those weeds it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 别急，等它先动。
lines.en: Be patient; let it move first.

lines.zh: 两颗心的鱼，只有一次机会。
lines.en: A two-heart fish gets one chance.

lines.zh: 准备，三、二、一，游！
lines.en: Ready: three, two, one, swim!

lines.zh: 甩尾巴，打你手指。
lines.en: A tail slap across your fingers.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙小，可扎得深。
lines.en: I bite: small teeth, but they sink deep.

lines.zh: 蹦起来撞你，就这一下。
lines.en: I leap and hit you, once only.

lines.zh: 拍水溅你一脸，走开。
lines.en: I splash your face; go away.

lines.zh: 别抓我，鳞会掉一片。
lines.en: Do not grab me; a scale will peel off.

lines.zh: 我拼了，反正只有两颗心。
lines.en: I fight; two hearts leave nothing to lose.

lines.zh: 撞你手掌，撞完就跑。
lines.en: I bump your palm and bolt.

lines.zh: 水花是我的武器，别小看。
lines.en: Splash is my weapon; do not scorn it.

lines.zh: 疼不疼？我也疼。
lines.en: Does it hurt? So does this.

lines.zh: 咬住不放，除非你松手。
lines.en: I bite and hold until you let go.

lines.zh: 在浅水里睁开眼，四处是草。
lines.en: Eyes open in the shallows, weeds all around.

lines.zh: 出生就两颗心，游得很小心。
lines.en: Born with two hearts, I swim carefully.

lines.zh: 这条河我不熟，先绕一圈。
lines.en: This river is new; I circle it once.

lines.zh: 水面上的世界太吵了。
lines.en: The world above the water is far too loud.

lines.zh: 刚孵出来，鳞还是软的。
lines.en: Just hatched; my scales are still soft.

lines.zh: 同类在哪儿？一点没闻到。
lines.en: Where is my kin? I smell none at all.

lines.zh: 水草缝里最安全，先躲。
lines.en: The weed gaps are safest; hide first.

lines.zh: 第一条要记住的路，是退路。
lines.en: The first path to learn is the retreat.

lines.zh: 泡泡一串串往上冒，像我。
lines.en: Bubbles rise in strings, just like me.

lines.zh: 这就是主世界的河？好大。
lines.en: This is an Overworld river? So vast.

lines.zh: 水面烫得像开锅，我往泥里钻。
lines.en: The surface boils; I burrow into the mud.

lines.zh: 被甩到岸上，拼命拍尾巴。
lines.en: Flung onto the bank, I thrash my tail.

lines.zh: 空气里我张着嘴，缺氧。
lines.en: In the air I gape, starved of water.

lines.zh: 水底一声闷响，耳朵嗡嗡。
lines.en: A muffled blast below; my head rings.

lines.zh: 箭擦过背鳍，水花四溅。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my dorsal fin, splashing.

lines.zh: 紫色的光打进水里，麻。
lines.en: Purple light pierces the water and numbs me.

lines.zh: 水里没虫了，肚子空空。
lines.en: No bugs left in the water; my belly is empty.

lines.zh: 雷打进河里，全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the river; I tingle all over.

lines.zh: 水没了，下面是无底的空。
lines.en: The water ends; below is bottomless nothing.
